title: Workspace scaffold
description: Cargo workspace with all crate stubs, CI pipeline, `data/` directory with `biomes.toml`, `glyphs.toml`, `galaxies.toml`

title: Core types
description: `GalacticAddress`, `Biome`, `BiomeSubType`, `Discovery`, `System`, `Planet`, `PlayerBase`, `PlayerState`, galaxy table

title: Portal glyph converter
description: Bidirectional: hex ↔ emoji ↔ coordinates ↔ signal booster. Parsing accepts hex digits, emoji, or glyph names

title: Distance calculator
description: Euclidean voxel distance × 400 ly, with helper methods (`within`, `same_region`, `same_system`)
deliverable: Unit tests with known coordinate pairs

title: LZ4 block decompressor
description: Read `save.hg`, detect format, parse block headers (magic `0xFEEDA1E5`), decompress with `lz4_flex`, concatenate
deliverable: Decompresses a real save file to JSON

title: Metadata verifier
description: Read `mf_save.hg`, XXTEA decrypt, verify SHA-256 and SpookyHash V2

title: Key deobfuscation
description: Load `mapping.json`, recursive key replacement on parsed JSON

title: Serde deserialization
description: Typed structs for save file top-level structure, `DiscoveryManagerData`, `PlayerStateData` (key fields)
deliverable: Parse a full save into typed structs

title: Goatfungus JSON fixer
description: State-machine walker: fix `\xNN` → `\u00NN`, invalid escapes → double-backslash, inside strings only

title: `nms info` command
description: Save overview: version, platform, playtime, player location (with emoji glyphs), discovery counts, base count, biome summary

title: `nms convert` command
description: Full coordinate converter CLI: `--glyphs`, `--coords`, `--ga`, `--voxel` flags, emoji output

title: Galaxy model
description: `GalaxyModel` struct: petgraph, R-tree spatial index, lookup HashMaps. Constructor from parsed `SaveData`

title: Spatial indexing
description: R-tree (`rstar`) insertion of all systems by voxel position. Nearest-N and within-radius queries

title: Graph construction
description: k-nearest-neighbor edge generation, warp-range-constrained edges, configurable strategy
deliverable: Graph with edges for test data

title: Query engine
description: `FindQuery`, `ShowQuery`, `StatsQuery` types. Pure functions over `&GalaxyModel`
deliverable: Unit tests for each query type

title: Display layer
description: Pretty table formatter with emoji glyphs, distance formatting (K/M ly), biome color coding, truncation

title: `nms find` command
description: Search by biome, infested flag, distance (within/nearest), name pattern, discoverer. Sorted results with glyphs

title: `nms show` command
description: Detail view: system (all planets), planet (biome, seed, name), base (location, glyphs, type)

title: `nms stats` command
description: Biome distribution table, distance histogram, discovery counts by type, named vs unnamed breakdown

title: REPL skeleton
description: reedline loop, command parsing (reuse clap subcommands), exit/quit/help

title: Persistent history
description: History file at `~/.nms-copilot/history.txt`, up/down navigation, search

title: Tab completion
description: Complete command names, biome names, base names, system names from loaded model

title: Session context
description: `SessionState`: current position, active biome filter, warp range, last results. Commands: `set`, `reset`, `status`

title: Context-aware prompt
description: Prompt displays galaxy, active filters, model size: `[Euclid │ Lush │ 644 planets] 🚀`

title: rkyv serialization
description: Serialize `GalaxyModel` (discovery data + metadata) to rkyv archive. Rebuild indices on load

title: Cache management
description: Freshness check (save file mtime vs cache mtime), auto-rebuild on stale, `--no-cache` flag

title: Config file
description: `~/.nms-copilot/config.toml` for save path, defaults, display prefs. `toml` crate parsing

title: Dijkstra shortest path
description: Shortest path between two systems using petgraph's Dijkstra. Warp-range-limited edges
deliverable: Path with total distance and hop count

title: Nearest-neighbor TSP
description: Greedy nearest-neighbor traversal of a target set. Returns ordered visit list with total distance

title: 2-opt improvement
description: 2-opt local search on TSP solution. Iterates until no improving swap found

title: Hop-constrained routing
description: Route that respects max warp range per hop. Inserts intermediate waypoints if direct hop exceeds range
deliverable: Realistic routes for given ship class

title: Route query type
description: `RouteQuery` with target selection (biome filter, explicit list, within radius), algorithm choice, warp range

title: Route display
description: Step-by-step itinerary table: hop #, system name, portal glyphs (emoji), distance, cumulative distance

title: `nms route` command
description: `route --biome Scorched --warp-range 2500 --algo 2opt --from "Acadia National Park"`

title: Reachability analysis
description: Connected components within a given warp range. "Which systems can I reach from here?"

title: File watcher
description: `notify` crate monitoring save directory, debounced (500ms) change detection

title: Delta computation
description: Diff current model against re-parsed save: new discoveries, player position change, new bases

title: Incremental model update
description: `apply_delta()`: insert new systems/planets into graph + spatial index, update player position

title: Event channel
description: `tokio::sync::broadcast` or `crossbeam` channel distributing deltas to consumers

title: REPL integration
description: Background listener prints notifications: `🌅 New scan: "Metok-Kalpa" (Lush) at 🌅🕊️🐜🕊️...`

title: Cache invalidation
description: Watcher triggers cache update after applying deltas

title: Graceful handling
description: Handle mid-write detection (partial files), permission errors, save directory not found

title: MCP protocol layer
description: JSON-RPC over stdio transport, tool registration, request/response handling

title: `search_planets` tool
description: Search by biome, distance, name. Returns structured results with emoji glyphs

title: `plan_route` tool
description: Route planning with biome targets, warp range, algorithm selection

title: `where_am_i` tool
description: Current player location from live model: system, planet, coordinates, emoji glyphs

title: `whats_nearby` tool
description: Nearby systems/planets sorted by distance, with biome and discovery info

title: `show_system` / `show_base`
description: Detail views for systems and bases

title: `convert_coordinates` tool
description: Bidirectional glyph/coord conversion

title: Live update integration
description: Server subscribes to watcher delta channel, model stays current

title: SSE transport (optional)
description: Server-sent events transport for web-based AI clients

title: `nms export` command
description: Export filtered results as JSON, CSV. `--biome`, `--within`, `--format` flags

title: Shell completions
description: `clap_complete` for bash, zsh, fish

title: Multi-save support
description: Detect and list all save slots. `--slot` flag or interactive selector

title: Multi-galaxy support
description: Separate spatial index per galaxy, cross-galaxy queries, galaxy switching in REPL

title: NomNom format
description: Parser for NomNom export format (if distinct from standard deobfuscated JSON)

title: Documentation
description: README with screenshots/examples, rustdoc for all public APIs, CONTRIBUTING guide

title: Integration tests
description: End-to-end tests with fixture save files covering all commands

title: crates.io publishing
description: Publish `nms`, `nms-core`, `nms-save`, `nms-graph`, `nms-copilot` to crates.io

title: Community data import
description: Import external coordinate lists (NMSCE, community CSV) as "external" discoveries

title: Color themes
description: Configurable color schemes for terminal output, biome color mapping
